title: Book Three · Chapter 167: Five Weeks in Summer
story:
Two more months pass, and the summer holiday begins.

During each month, Mum and Dad check the household book and make another payment. Dad puts in twelve yuan and Mum eight each time.

They write both dates on the envelope. The parents' study envelope now holds one hundred yuan. Ronan's twenty-seven and twenty and a half remain separate. Together they have one hundred and forty-seven and a half saved.

His application letter is clearer now. The teacher's note is ready too, and he keeps it with the form.

On Friday, he visits the workshop to ask about summer work.

Mr Sun looks at the coming weeks. There are morning collections and new customer drawings. He needs someone at the front while the adults work at the benches.

“Five weeks,” he says. “Monday, Wednesday, and Friday. Nine until twelve.”

Ronan copies the days.

“Starting this Monday?”

“Yes. Three yuan for each morning this time. You know the front work now. Nine each Friday after the three mornings.”

Ronan checks the end date. Five weeks will leave time before the new term. Anna is still preparing her drawings. He has no journey booked.

“I can do those mornings.”

Mr Sun writes the new agreement. Ronan puts a copy of the dates in his notebook.

Dad comes to the front with a finished drawer. He sets it down beside the collection papers.

“Our new helper?”

“Old helper,” Ronan says.

Dad looks at him. “Eighteen already. Very old.”

Mr Sun laughs and gives Ronan the first morning's task list. It starts with names, drawings, and finished pieces.

On Monday, Ronan arrives before nine. There is no pay in his pocket yet. He puts his water beside the counter and takes the long pencil from its place.

He checks the first customer's papers. A measurement is missing, so he leaves a question beside the drawing for Mr Sun.

Later, a woman brings two different ideas for a low table. Ronan asks where it will stand and how she will use it.

She puts one drawing back in her bag.

“For books,” she says. “And tea sometimes.”

“Then we need room for both.”

She smiles and shows him the wider drawing. Ronan writes her answer beneath it before he calls Mr Sun over.

At twelve, he puts the papers in their place and washes his hands. Dad is still working at the back. Ronan lifts a hand, then goes home for lunch with the first morning finished.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

payment＝实际付入的钱；collection＝取货；agreement＝工作约定；measurement＝量得的尺寸。

## 理解问题

1. 新五周工作是哪几天、几点至几点、怎样付款？首个周一已领到整周工资了吗？
2. 这两个月父母实际又存了几次？他们及三份合计的现有学习钱各是多少？

## 读句子

**I can do those mornings.**

拆开看：I / can do / those mornings.

我／能够承担／约好的那些工作日上午。
